title: Project Alpha
description: Modern web platform for a growing business.
overview: A comprehensive web platform designed to scale with the client's growing business needs. We focused on performance, accessibility, and a clean user experience from the ground up.
approach: We started with a focused discovery phase to understand the core problem, then moved into rapid prototyping and iteration. The team worked in tight feedback loops — designing, building, and testing in parallel to ship faster without sacrificing quality.
outcome: The final product was delivered on time and on budget, with a clean codebase, comprehensive test coverage, and deployment infrastructure in place. The client now has a solid foundation to build upon as their business grows.

title: Project Nova
description: AI-powered product designed around a focused workflow.
overview: An AI-powered product that integrates large language models into a focused, distraction-free workflow tool. We designed the UX to feel natural and intelligent without overwhelming users with AI complexity.
approach: Research-first approach. We ran user interviews, mapped existing workflows, and designed a product that felt like a natural extension of how people already work. The AI layer was carefully embedded so it feels assistive rather than intrusive.
outcome: Shipped a lean, focused MVP that users praised for its simplicity. The AI features work invisibly in the background, surfacing when relevant and staying out of the way when not needed.

title: Project Orbit
overview: A high-converting e-commerce experience built around storytelling and brand identity. Every interaction was designed to reduce friction and guide users naturally toward purchase decisions.
approach: We collaborated closely with the client's brand team to build a store that felt as premium as their products. GSAP animations, custom product configurators, and a streamlined checkout flow were the key technical challenges.
outcome: Launched with strong conversion rates from day one. The client reported a measurable uplift in average order value attributed to the improved product presentation and simplified checkout.
